name: Macroeconomics II
description: This is a half-semester graduate-level macroeconomics course designed primarily for students doing MSc in economics. The course blends conceptual, model-building, and data-oriented approaches, with a strong focus on theoretical modeling. Class size is limited to facilitate in-depth discussion and engagement. This course offers a rigorous introduction to the process of economic growth and the long-run sources of cross-country differences in economic performance. Students will develop a theoretical toolkit by engaging with key models and analytical frameworks used in modern macroeconomics. The course is structured to blend foundational theory with empirical insights and historical experiences.
